verification.method: Cumulative per-record anonymous OCI HTTP GET checks; SHA-256 verified for manifests, configurations and every referenced layer
verification.scope: 91 listed runtime images; each retains its own timestamped anonymousDownload proof. Required public companions are verified during their publication reconciliation and are not runtime catalog entries.
verification.freshness: checkedAt is the catalog reconciliation time. It does not refresh unchanged records; use each anonymousDownload.verifiedAt.

latestReconciliation.proofAccess: Retained GitLab artifact; project access may be required

signatureProvenance: Signature status comes from the original GitLab publication CI records and their hash-checked verification outputs. 77 listed runtime records contain complete recorded signed annotation values; 14 lack complete values and require the linked original publication record. Anonymous OCI byte verification does not repeat cryptographic signature verification or execute images.
evidenceAccess: Publication job links and retained qualification evidence may require GitLab access.
